name: chainpe-wallet
display_name: ChainPe — Arbitrum Wallet for AI Agents
description: Arbitrum wallet for Claude. Discover ChainPe services on-chain and pay for them with x402 USDC — no API keys, no accounts.
long_description:
Give Claude an Arbitrum wallet wired into the ChainPe marketplace. ChainPe adds tools for:

- **search_bazaar** — Discover x402-gated services from the ChainPe registry, the x402 Bazaar and ERC-8004 agents
- **x402_fetch** — Fetch a service URL with automatic x402 payment handling
- **check_balance** — View your USDC and ETH balance and wallet address
- **pay** — Sign an x402 payment authorization (USDC on Arbitrum)
- **transfer_usdc** — Send USDC to any address on Arbitrum
- **transfer_eth** — Send native ETH for gas
- **spending_report** — Review what the agent has spent today
- **request_funding** — Generate an EIP-681 top-up link
- **give_feedback** — Post an on-chain ERC-8004 reputation score

Use your wallet private key to pay with USDC on Arbitrum Sepolia (testnet) or Arbitrum One (mainnet).

Budget limits protect your funds: set max per call and max per day.

private_key.title: Wallet Private Key (0x…)
private_key.description: Your EVM wallet private key. Used to sign x402 USDC payments on Arbitrum. Stored securely in your OS keychain.

network.title: Default Network
network.description: Payment network: arbitrum-sepolia (testnet) or arbitrum (Arbitrum One mainnet).

max_per_call.title: Max USDC per Payment
max_per_call.description: Maximum USDC allowed per single payment. Safety limit.

max_per_day.title: Max USDC per Day
max_per_day.description: Maximum total USDC allowed per calendar day.

chainpe_registry_address.title: ChainPe Registry Address
chainpe_registry_address.description: Address of the ChainPeRegistry contract on Arbitrum. Required for search_bazaar until the default deployment is published.

erc8004_reputation_registry.title: ERC-8004 Reputation Registry
erc8004_reputation_registry.description: Address of the ERC-8004 Reputation Registry. Leave blank to use the canonical registry for the network.

tools.name: search_bazaar
tools.description: Discover x402-gated services from the ChainPe registry, the x402 Bazaar and ERC-8004 agents. Returns name, price, tags, reputation, and endpoint.

tools.name: x402_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a service URL with automatic x402 payment. Handles 402 responses by signing the USDC payment and retrying.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Check USDC and ETH balance and wallet address on the configured network.

tools.name: pay
tools.description: Sign an x402 USDC payment authorization. Returns the payment header value.

tools.name: transfer_usdc
tools.description: Send USDC on-chain to any address on Arbitrum.

tools.name: transfer_eth
tools.description: Send native ETH on Arbitrum (for gas).

tools.name: spending_report
tools.description: Show how much USDC the agent has spent today and the configured limits.

tools.name: request_funding
tools.description: Generate an EIP-681 link to top up the wallet with USDC or ETH.

tools.name: give_feedback
tools.description: Post an on-chain ERC-8004 reputation score (0–100) for a service provider's agent.
